api.dom.createOverlayBy:
Create an overlay element that can be tracked sustainably (can be adjusted according to the size of the target element and the window scroll, size change, etc.).
Target elements can be elements that do not exist in the document, when the target element is appended to the document, this overlay element will be immediately overlaid on the target element; correspondingly, if the target element is deleted from the document, the overlay element will not be visible.
api.dom.createOverlayBy.bindWindowStr: Binding key on window, then you can find this created overlay element through window[bindWindowStr]
api.dom.createOverlayBy.createObserver: Whether to set the observer for the target element. The default is true
api.dom.createOverlayBy.delayTime: The delay time of the overlay element following the change of the target element (unit: milliseconds), default 500
api.dom.createOverlayBy.fn: Target element position and size change callback function
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder:
Create an overlay element that can be tracked sustainably (can be adjusted according to the size of the target element and the window scroll, size change, etc.).
Four elements can be elements that do not exist in the document, when the target element is appended to the document, this overlay element will be immediately overlaid on the target element; correspondingly, if the target element is deleted from the document, the overlay element will not be visible.
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.bindWindow: Binding key on window, then you can find this created overlay element through window[bindWindowStr]
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.top: If the type is a number, it means the distance from the corresponding edge in pixels; if the type is a string, it is a css or xpath selector, then it is the target element of the overlay layer on the top, the default is the bottom of the corresponding target element, otherwise you need to add :top at the end of the selector, corresponding to the top of the target element.
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.right: If the type is a number, it means the distance from the corresponding edge in pixels; if the type is a string, it is a css or xpath selector, then it is the target element of the overlay layer on the right, the default is the left of the corresponding target element, otherwise you need to add :right at the end of the selector, corresponding to the right of the target element.
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.bottom: If the type is a number, it means the distance from the corresponding edge in pixels; if the type is a string, it is a css or xpath selector, then it is the target element of the overlay layer on the bottom, the default is the top of the corresponding target element, otherwise you need to add :bottom at the end of the selector, corresponding to the top of the target element.
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.left: If the type is a number, it means the distance from the corresponding edge in pixels; if the type is a string, it is a css or xpath selector, then it is the target element of the overlay layer on the left, the default is the right of the corresponding target element, otherwise you need to add :left at the end of the selector, corresponding to the left of the target element.
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.createObse: Whether to set the observer for the target element. The default is true
api.dom.createOverlayByBorder.delayTime: The delay time of the overlay element following the change of the target element (unit: milliseconds), default 500

api.dom.addResizeListener.callback: Target element position and size change callback function

api.http.ajax: Send an HTTP request. The actual request is executed in the browser main process, so it is not restricted by the page's CORS policy.
api.http.ajax.options.data: Request data. GET/HEAD requests serialize it into the query string; other requests write it to the body
api.http.ajax.options.timeout: Timeout in milliseconds; takes effect when greater than 0
api.http.ajax.options.dataType: Response data type: json, text, html, or arrayBuffer. Defaults to json
api.http.ajax.options.contentType: Request body Content-Type. Defaults to application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8
api.http.ajax.options.processData: Whether to serialize request data automatically. Defaults to true
api.http.ajax.return: Request result. On success, ok is true and data is returned; on failure, ok is false and error or timeout may be returned
api.header: Get the value of the specified request/response header
api.header.isRequestHeader: Whether it is a request header
